front.prompt: Contemporary browser adventure artwork, flat opaque colors, three discrete cel-shading bands, thin colored outlines, clean silhouette, no texture noise, no gradients, no pastel wash, no photorealism. Match reference exactly: miniature 2–2.5 heads tall red hooded adventurer, navy clothes, brown chunky boots and wooden bow, brass waist reel. Light from upper left. Genuine transparent background, no shadows or text. Four separate full-body poses in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid; identical character scale, hood size, feet baseline within each cell, and generous padding. Reference is the identity and palette reference. Create four FRONT view archery frames, facing directly toward the viewer. Crucial correction: aim straight OUT OF THE IMAGE toward the viewer, with real foreshortening, NEVER a side-on horizontal arrow pointing left or right. The bow is held forward, nearly edge-on, its upper and lower wooden limbs vertical; the arrow points toward the viewer and is seen almost end-on, not as a long sideways shaft. Keep the bow in character's LEFT hand (viewer right), reel at character's RIGHT hip (viewer left), with right hand drawing back toward cheek. Head faces camera; torso can turn naturally for archery while boots stay planted. Top left: raising bow, no arrow. Top right: half drawn toward viewer, tiny end-on arrowhead. Bottom left: fully drawn toward viewer, foreshortened arrowhead, draw hand at cheek, eyes concentrating. Bottom right: just released toward viewer, bow hand still forward, draw hand relaxed near cheek, NO arrow. Keep arms short and anatomy consistent. Do not add equipment or alter clothing.

back.prompt: Contemporary browser adventure artwork, flat opaque colors, three discrete cel-shading bands, thin colored outlines, clean silhouette, no texture noise, no gradients, no pastel wash, no photorealism. Match reference exactly: miniature 2–2.5 heads tall red hooded adventurer, navy clothes, brown chunky boots and wooden bow, brass waist reel. Light from upper left. Genuine transparent background, no shadows or text. Four separate full-body poses in an evenly spaced 2 by 2 grid; identical character scale, hood size, feet baseline within each cell, and generous padding. Reference is the identity and palette reference. Create four BACK view archery frames, facing directly AWAY from the viewer. Crucial correction: aim straight INTO THE IMAGE, away from camera, NEVER show a sideways horizontal arrow pointing left or right. The back of the red hood fully hides the face. Bow is held ahead of the body, nearly edge-on, mostly occluded by hood/shoulder, with upper limb peeking above left shoulder and lower limb near left forearm. Arrow shaft is hidden by the hood and strong foreshortening; NO long visible horizontal arrow. Keep bow in character's LEFT hand (viewer left), reel at character's RIGHT hip (viewer right), and draw with right hand. Top left: raising bow forward. Top right: half draw away from viewer, right hand approaching cheek, no sideways shaft. Bottom left: full draw away from viewer, right hand by hidden cheek, shoulders engaged. Bottom right: release away from viewer, left hand forward and right hand relaxes near shoulder, no arrow. All full-body standing poses. Keep arms short and equipment on the same anatomical sides.
